Survival for the fittest- Adoption of AI |
An opportunity or a threat
By Dr. Amit Kumar Bhardwaj
& Dr. Rishabh

Leading Indian AI Products & Platforms
Haptik
• Product: Enterprise conversational AI platform
(text & voice chatbots)
• Used in sectors like insurance, e-commerce,
government (MyGov Corona Helpdesk reached
30M+ users)
Yellow.ai
• Product: Omnichannel customer support
automation platform; also launched YellowG, a
small generative AI model
Krutrim ("Kruti")
• Product: Kruti, India's first agentic AI assistant—
books taxis, orders food, pays bills; supports 13
Indian languages
Sarvam AI
• Products: Language-specific LLMs for 10 Indian
languages, voice-enabled chatbots, and open-
source 2B-parameter model “Sarvam 2B | Lumio AI
• Product: Lumio, a multi-model AI platform that
lets users compare and switch between ChatGPT,
Gemini, Claude, and more via a single interface
CoRover.ai ("BharatGPT")
• Product: BharatGPT, a sovereign AI assistant
offering text, voice, and video outputs tailored for
India
Zoho Corporation
• Product: In-house LLM and AI agents integrated
across its productivity suite—for tasks like
drafting, analysis, and automation

slides.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
slides.text:
Artificial Intelligence (AI)
Broadest field – simulates human intelligence. Includes everything from rule-based systems to learning algorithms. Example: Chatbots, facial recognition, recommendation engines. Machine Learning (ML)
Subset of AI – enables systems to learn from data. Example: Spam email filtering, stock prediction, language translation. Deep Learning (DL)
Subset of ML – uses neural networks to mimic the human brain. Example: Voice assistants, image classification, autonomous driving.

slides.text:
1️⃣ Content Creation
AI writes blogs, ad copies, product descriptions. Example: Jasper AI, ChatGPT creating Instagram captions. 2️⃣ Customer Engagement
AI chatbots and assistants offer 24/7 support. Example: Haptik or Drift answering FAQs instantly. 3️⃣ Marketing Automation
Automates emails, SMS, and campaigns. Example: Mailchimp sending birthday offers automatically. 4️⃣ Predictive Analytics
AI predicts future trends from data. Example: Forecasting sales spikes before Diwali using historical data. 5️⃣ Digital Marketing
AI optimizes ad spend, targeting, and A/B testing. Example: Google Ads auto-bidding based on user behavior. 6️⃣ Ads & Targeting
AI delivers personalized ads to the right audience. Example: Meta (Facebook) suggesting products based on your browsing.

AI in HRM
Recruitment & Hiring
Automates resume screening and candidate
matching.
• Onboarding
Delivers personalized welcome kits, FAQs, and
training schedules.
• Employee Training
Uses AI tutors, adaptive learning platforms
(e.g., Coursera, LinkedIn Learning).
• Performance Evaluation
Tracks KPIs and gives unbiased feedback
reports.
• Employee Engagement
Monitors sentiment, recommends wellness
activities, AI chatbots for HR queries.
• Talent Management
Identifies high-potential employees and
suggests career development paths

slides.text:
AI In Accounting & Finance Management
Key Functions:
• Transaction Coding
Automates data entry & classification of expenses.
• Invoice Processing
Extracts data, verifies, and processes bills faster.
• Expense Reporting
Tracks spending and flags anomalies.
• Financial Analysis
Forecasts trends, prepares dashboards, aids decision-
making.
• Talent Management
Optimizes hiring for finance roles via predictive analytics.
• Risk Assessment
Evaluates financial risks and credit scores.
• Fraud Detection
Flags suspicious activity using AI pattern recognition.

slides.text:
AI In Operation Management And Supply Chain
Management
Key Roles:
• Demand Forecasting
Predicts future product demand using data
trends.
• Inventory Management
Tracks stock levels & automates reordering.
• Quality Control
Detects product defects using AI vision systems.
• Predictive Maintenance
Prevents machine failures by forecasting
maintenance needs.
• Supply Chain Optimization
Improves logistics, reduces delays, and cuts
costs.
• Autonomous Vehicles
Enables driverless transport & smart deliveries.

slides.title: Companies Using AI in industry 4.0
slides.text:
Companies Using AI in industry 4.0
1. In Predictive maintenance, optimize production processes, and reduce downtime examples General Electric (GE), Siemens, Bosch, Caterpillar etc. 2. Insights into manufacturing processes Example IBM, Companies use Watson to analyze sensor data, predict equipment failures, and optimize production lines. 3. Automate quality checks and optimize assembly lines Example Tesla 4. Optimize logistics and warehouse operations. Example Amazon, ML algorithms help in forecasting demand, managing inventory, and improving delivery routes. 5. Enhance manufacturing efficiency. Example ABB, integrates machine learning into its robotics and automation solutions. 6. Precision agriculture solutions by John Deere 7. Optimize the supply chain and manufacturing processes by Procter & Gamble (P&G)

slides.text:
Top Career Opportunities for AI-Literate MBA
Graduates
1 ️⃣ AI Product Manager
• Bridge between business, data, and engineering.
Define AI use cases, manage data-driven products.
Common in tech firms, fintech, healthcare, and retail.
2 ️⃣ Business Analyst / AI Strategy Consultant
• Use AI tools to drive business insights and recommend
automation strategies.
• Employers: Deloitte, McKinsey, EY, BCG, Accenture.
3 ️⃣ Digital Transformation Manager
• Lead AI adoption across departments like supply chain,
finance, and HR
• Common in manufacturing, logistics, BFSI, and telecom.
4 ️⃣ Marketing Intelligence Specialist
• Use AI for predictive analytics, personalized ads, and
campaign optimization.
• Popular in e-commerce, FMCG, digital agencies. | 5 ️⃣ AI-Powered Finance Roles
• Risk modeling, fraud detection, algorithmic trading, credit
scoring using AI.
• Companies: Goldman Sachs, Paytm, Razorpay, ICICI.
6 ️⃣ Operations & Supply Chain Analyst (AI-enabled)
• AI tools for demand forecasting, route optimization, warehouse
automation.
• Logistics firms, manufacturing, Big 4 consulting.
7 ️⃣ Talent Analytics / HR Tech Consultant
• Use AI for workforce planning, hiring automation, and
employee retention.
• HR tech companies and large corporates.
8 ️⃣ Chief AI Officer / Innovation Lead (long-term)
• For senior MBAs or those progressing into leadership roles.
• Drive enterprise AI strategy and ecosystem building.
